# FAQs

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#faqs


## What did we announce with CAP v9?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#what-did-we-announce-with-cap-v9


SAP SE announced a transition from the [_SAP Developer License 3.1_](https://tools.hana.ondemand.com/developer-license-3_1.txt) and [_SAP Developer License 3.2_](https://tools.hana.ondemand.com/developer-license-3_2.txt) to the [_SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_](https://cap.cloud.sap/resources/license/developer-license-3_2_CAP.txt) for all releases of all CAP libraries that are not under the Apache License 2.0. The change applies from CAP v9 (released May 2025) and all subsequent releases.



## Why are we making this change?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#why-are-we-making-this-change


The formerly used _SAP Developer License 3.1 / 3.2_ imposed strict rules on CAP users with respect to usage and customer support. By shifting to the _SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_, SAP allows customers of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) or any other SAP platform to use CAP applications productively and to request support in line with their existing licensing agreement with SAP.



## Which parts of CAP are affected?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#which-parts-of-cap-are-affected


The updated license applies for all CAP components which are not published with an Open-Source license. The license applies to both CAP Java and CAP Node.js.

## What are the implications of this change for users of CAP?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#what-are-the-implications-of-this-change-for-users-of-cap


Customers and partners and external developers in general are granted to create custom applications for productive use that are operated on BTP or any other platform licensed from SAP. In the _SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_ those applications are called “Customer Productive Applications”. In setups that deviate from this, CAP shall only be used for testing purposes and/or non-productive use (called “Customer Test Applications”).

While the former _SAP Developer License 3.1 / 3.2_ limits mass data extraction from an SAP product to a non-SAP product, including use, modification, saving or other processing of such data in the non-SAP product, the new _SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_ is defining an exception to the extent that the extraction is solely used for and required for interoperability with an SAP product. Allowing this, applications for e.g. product extensions are supported and interoperability of applications is enhanced.



## Who is impacted by this change?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#who-is-impacted-by-this-change


All users of CAP are affected starting with CAP v9.

## What are the implications on the CAP Open Source strategy?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#what-are-the-implications-on-the-cap-open-source-strategy


The change of CAP’s license model has **no implications on the CAP Open Source strategy**. Many CAP components and CAP plugins are already open source (mostly with Apache License 2.0) and the number will continue to grow.



## What is a _Customer Productive Application_?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#what-is-a-customer-productive-application


The _SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_ defines “Customer Applications”. These are in general applications developed using the CAP application programming interfaces, documentations, plugins, templates, scripts, sample code or tools. “Customer Test Applications” are for testing and non-productive use. Only if deployed and operated on BTP or any other platform licensed from SAP, productive usage is allowed and supported. These are the mentioned “Customer Productive Applications”.



## What do _You_ and _Your Customer_ mean?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#what-do-you-and-your-customer-mean


Some places in the _SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_ mention CAP users and their customers (“You and Your customers”) which should emphasize that we encourage third parties / partners to implement CAP applications for their customers as Customer Productive Applications (see [What is a Customer Productive Application](#what-is-a-customer-productive-application)).



## Can I get support if I have issues with CAP?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#can-i-get-support-if-i-have-issues-with-cap


We offer support for Customer Productive Applications that are developed and made available by You in accordance with the _SAP Developer License 3.2 CAP_. You and third parties may request support in line with Your licensing agreement for SAP. All other users are referred to what is made available on the SAP Community Website by SAP at its sole discretion and by SAP Community members. For Open-Source CAP components under Apache License 2.0, the official GitHub support channels (GitHub issues) are available.



## Can I continue to use previous versions of CAP that were provided under the original _SAP Developer License 3.1 / 3.2_?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#can-i-continue-to-use-previous-versions-of-cap-that-were-provided-under-the-original-sap-developer-license-31--32


The license change is not retroactive. This means, all source code and releases prior to the change remain under the _SAP Developer License 3.1 / 3.2_. For using CAP applications in productive environments, we strongly recommend to upgrade though. Support for older CAP versions is limited to the CAP release and support strategy that is described in [CAP Release Schedule](../releases/schedule).



## Will SAP provide security patches to previous releases under the original _SAP Developer License 3.1 / 3.2_?

> Source: /docs/resources/cap-license#will-sap-provide-security-patches-to-previous-releases-under-the-original-sap-developer-license-31--32


SAP will continue to patch critical security patches, as available, to existing versions under the _SAP Developer License 3.1 / 3.2_ for one year, as outlined in the [CAP Release Schedule](../releases/schedule). Any patches after that date will be provided under the new license only, because older CAP versions will fall out of maintenance then.

# PPMS Components for CAP <Internal />

> Source: /docs/resources/ppms


Using either the CAP Node.js  or the Java runtime, an SAP application has to reference the corresponding CAP Software Component Version (SCV) in PPMS.
For referencing CAP SCVs correctly you have to know the version you are using. If you are additionally using multitenancy scenarios applying the [@cap/cds-mtxs](/@external/guides/multitenancy/mtxs) package, you have also to map MTXS to your PPMS.

The following tables inform about the mapping of CAP release version to PPMS Build Version of the corresponding components.

## Java

> Source: /docs/resources/ppms#java


Since publishing of the major version June 2026, you are asked to reference for the Java runtime of CAP the SCV [CDS SERVICES JAVA SDK 5](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028302/overview).
The table shows the mapping between CAP releases and the corresponding Build Version in PPMS. Still on the [current LTS version](/releases/schedule)? Then please reference that last version of [CDS SERVICES JAVA SDK 4](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73555000100200023913/overview) as given in the following table. Note: older versions are not longer supported.

| CAP release   |   cds.java version    | PPMS Version  (link to PPMS)
|---------------|-----------------------| ---------------------------
| [LTS version 4.9](/releases/2026/apr26) | cds.java 4.9.x        | [BV for 2604 V4.0 / SPS009](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73555000100200023913/build-versions?selected=73555000101000081487)
| [2026 June](/releases/2026/jun26) | cds.java 5.0.x       | [BV for 2606 V5.0](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028302/build-versions?selected=73554900101000092276)
| [2026 August](/releases/2026/aug26) | cds.java 5.1.x       | [BV for 2608 V5.0](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028302/build-versions?selected=73554900101000096462)

## Node.js

> Source: /docs/resources/ppms#nodejs


For the Node.js runtime of CAP you have to reference the SCV [CDS_UMBRELLA V10](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028306/overview).
The table shows the mapping between CAP releases and the corresponding Build Version of the Build Version in PPMS. Still on the [current LTS version](/releases/schedule)? Then please reference that last version of [CDS_UMBRELLA V9](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73555000100200023808/overview) as given in the following table. Note: older versions are not longer supported.

| CAP release   |   cds.js version    | PPMS Version
|---------------|-----------------------| -------------------------
| [LTS version 9.9](/releases/2026/apr26) | cds.js 9.9.x        | [BV for 2604 v9 / SPS009](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73555000100200023808/build-versions?selected=73555000101000081485)
| [2026 June](/releases/2026/jun26) | cds.js 10.0.x        | [BV for 2606 v10](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028306/build-versions?selected=73554900101000092280)
| [2026 August](/releases/2026/aug26) | cds.js 10.1.x        | [BV for 2608 v10](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028306/build-versions?selected=73554900101000096417)

## MTXS

> Source: /docs/resources/ppms#mtxs


For the @sap/cds-mtxs component of CAP you have to reference the SCV [CDS_SIDECAR V10](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028305/overview).
The table shows the mapping between CAP releases and the corresponding Build Version of the Support Package in PPMS. This component has to be referenced in addition, if you are using CAP (either Java or Node.js) in MTXS scenarios. Still on the [current LTS version](/releases/schedule)? Then please reference the last version of  [CDS_SIDECAR V9](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73555000100200023917/overview) as given in the following table. Note: older versions are not longer supported.

| CAP release   |   cds-mtxs version    | PPMS Version
|---------------|-----------------------| ------------------------
| [LTS version 2.7.x](/releases/2025/mar25) | cds.mtxs 3.9.x        | [BV for 2604 v9 / SPS009](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73555000100200023917/build-versions?selected=73555000101000081483)
| [2026 June](/releases/2026/jun26) | cds-mtxs 4.0.x        | [BV for 2606 v10](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028305/build-versions?selected=73554900101000092279)
| [2026 August](/releases/2026/aug26) | cds-mtxs 4.1.x        | [BV for 2608 v10](https://i7p.wdf.sap.corp/ppmslight/#/details/cv/73554900100200028305/build-versions?selected=73554900101000096419)

# Service Inventory for CAP <Internal />

> Source: /docs/resources/service-inventory


Services and applications that have an entry in [Service Inventory](https://inventory.services.tools.sap/cp.portal/site#Shell-home) are asked to reference the CAP Node.js runtime or the Java runtime as _Outward Link_ to indicate that service / application is depending on CAP.



- Java runtime of CAP: [Service-1738](https://inventory.services.tools.sap/cp.portal/site#Services-Maintain?sap-ui-app-id-hint=sap.tools.services.inventory.app.services&/Services(ID='SERVICE-1738',IsActiveEntity=true)?layout=TwoColumnsMidExpanded&sap-iapp-state=TAS4Y60INUXD2ALBNZRIS0Q2RT5YV68ZNHUSAZUJI)

- Node.js runtime of CAP: [Service-1739](https://inventory.services.tools.sap/cp.portal/site#Services-Maintain?sap-ui-app-id-hint=sap.tools.services.inventory.app.services&/Services(ID=%27SERVICE-1739%27,IsActiveEntity=true)?layout=TwoColumnsMidExpanded&sap-iapp-state=TAS3BVJX40O7M4YLAB3RFOG53IJRNB0P2FZUL53FV)
